items.title: Fred Staton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 12, 2008
items.q: of Jimmy Rushing being on the dance floor and he’s the last one standing or something.

ctx.x: Yeah. And they’d have these funny things with, they were almost like just little story lines, of Jimmy Rushing being on the dance floor and he’s the last one standing or something. Were those things used in the movie houses? It seemed like they were just short pieces of some of the swing bands playing, and I wondered, where would you see them back in the thirties and forties.
That’s a good question. We wouldn’t see them. They weren’t there. No.
